text_markup: If the trigger cost of a paid ability begins with a [click] symbol, the ability is an {term:action}. A player can use one action paid ability during each action window on their turn. See {ref:rule_action_window} and {ref:sec_actions}.
text_plain: If the trigger cost of a paid ability begins with a {click} symbol, the ability is an action. A player can use one action paid ability during each action window on their turn. See section 9.2.6 and section 5.2.
